hook: No fine for driving alone: traffic police call *congestion fine* fake
hook_b: No fine for driving alone: traffic police call *congestion fine* fake
tldr: Hyderabad Traffic Police flagged social media posts and reels claiming motorists would be fined for travelling alone in a car as false; no congestion penalty has been proposed.

beats.what: On Nov 26 the traffic police posted a fake news alert: there is no fine for travelling alone in a car, and claims of a new 'congestion fine' are unverified.
beats.why: The reels followed Cyberabad Moves 2026, where mobility experts from Bogotá and London suggested congestion charges and parking reforms in a panel discussion.
beats.care: Nothing changes for car users now; police ask people to rely only on their official handles and helpline 9010203626.

event.label: Reels claimed solo drivers will be fined

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Experts' panel suggestions (peak-hour charges, ending free office parking) were not government decisions, police said.

cards.q: Did you see the solo-driver fine reel before this?

qs: If a congestion charge were ever proposed, who would decide it and how would the public be consulted?
What share of IT corridor commuters have a workable bus or metro option?

facts.t: *10,138* people drove alone near Cyber Towers in the morning peak; *3,584* travelled two to a car.

viz.l: Cars near Cyber Towers, morning peak (people)
viz.verdict: Most car commuters in the IT hub travel solo; no fine applies to them.

watch: Whether any parking or congestion policy is formally proposed; police say none is on the table now.
